communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-904712821
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $210.5 on my statement from Fashion Outlet. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Sarah Chen

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-904712821
communications.body: I contacted Fashion Outlet's customer service via their website's contact form on February 1, 2026, explaining the discrepancy and the defect. After several days, they responded on February 5, 2026, stating that all sales are final and that 'slight variations' in color and material composition are possible due to screen settings and supplier changes. They offered a 10% discount on a future purchase but refused a refund or return, claiming the item 'meets their quality standards.' This resolution is unacceptable as the difference is substantial, not a 'slight variation,' and the item is defective.
